scope: All original app/rag Python files and every current declaration, including removed/moved/new declarations and verified necessary caller deltas.

checks.scope: Currently sealed reviewed files; in-progress files are deliberately not reported as checked.
limits: No runtime imports or evaluation of third-party SDK/model code. Import bindings are source-level only; explicit lazy __all__ is accepted.
No pytest, application lifespan, model/provider/business HTTP/DB/Docker or Git mutation.

coverage.note: Named-direct match is deliberately conservative: moved/renamed/current delta names need explicit mapping before final coverage closure.

behavior_verification.other_batches: Named per-batch evidence is linked from the full coverage ledger and individual declaration decisions; group counts use each batch own unit and are not summed as a single homogeneous test count.

failure_policy: Actual optional provider/diagnostic failures keep visible audit or warnings and original content; mandatory internal/authorization/persistence/cleanup contracts stay explicit. Normal no-result and unknown measurement remain distinct.
limitations: No pytest or tests edits. No actual model/OCR provider, business HTTP, DB/Redis, Docker or app lifespan execution; finite fake/source ports and guarded imports prove only their stated contracts.
Local NLTK and tokenizer vocabulary resources are absent; actual tokenization needs the deployment dependencies and does not fabricate an empty working dictionary.
Chart vendor raw payload compatibility retained; unrecognized vendor contents were not inferred to be successful normalized chart series.

Existing identity readers trim outer key whitespace; significant trailing-space business IDs were not established as supported. Generator delimiter injectivity is not claimed as an all-input end-to-end identity guarantee.
Static import bindings cover explicit source imports and the actual lazy chunker export registry, not arbitrary runtime-generated calls.
